title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-K677ES) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Clean audience recording captures a smoking MSG show with an inspired 12‑minute Shakedown Street and a strong second set.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers a pretty clean sound that lets the crowd electricity of an MSG night shine through, featuring a 12‑minute, inspired Jerry on Shakedown Street and crisp renditions of El Paso and Terrapin Station. The second set stays solid with Scarlet/Fire, Truckin', The Other One and a plaintive Stella Blue, despite a brief sloppy bridge in Scarlet/Fire.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review rates the show 4 stars; musical performance is praised as strong with several standout moments, while recording quality is described as clean and enjoyable.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is pretty clean with good crowd presence; no major drop‑outs mentioned, only typical audience tape ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds with strong openings and rare gems; second set solidifies with a tight back half despite a minor hiccup.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Inspired 12‑minute performance on Shakedown Street, highlighted as a show highlight.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals described as staggered but present during the opening.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's vocals noted as staggered; no specific keyboard commentary.
